treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Kingdom of Denmark and the Government of the State of Kuwait for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (2010)
eif_quote: Overenskomsten trådte i medfør af artikel 29 i kraft den 2. oktober 2013.
source_title: BKI nr 17 af 09/10/2013 (agreement + protocol, DA/EN; Arabic omitted)

rates.quote: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends where such holding is being possessed for an uninterrupted period of no less than one year and the dividends are declared within that period;
d) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
1. Interest arising in a Contracting State paid to a resident of the other Contracting State who is the beneficial owner of such interest shall be taxable only in that other Contracting State.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that Contracting State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of such royalties.

ppt.basis: none - Kuwait not an MLI Party; treaty has no PPT/main-purpose clause

notes: Art. 29: retroactive effect - 'in respect of taxes withheld at source, for amounts paid or credited on or after the first day of January of the year in which this Agreement is signed' -> 2010-01-01 (skat.dk: 'Virkning 01.01.2010'). Dividend 0% tier requires an uninterrupted holding of at least one year (treaty's own condition, modelled as 365 days). Protocol point 2: where dividends paid by a Danish company to a Kuwaiti company are taxed in Kuwait at a rate below 15%, Denmark may levy up to 15% (source_state DK override of the 0% tier - not modelled). Art. 10(2)(b): 0% for the other State/government institutions; art. 10(2)(c): 5% for recognised pension funds - not modelled. Protocol point 3 (Arts 11-12 anti-conduit): source State may apply domestic law to interest/royalties paid to entities >50% owned/controlled by non-EU/EEA third-country persons that would not have obtained equal treaty relief directly. MLI not applicable (Kuwait signed but is not a Party).
